title: Making baskets: an art adventure
creator_credit: Easy Street Productions and Bill Mackie
brief_description: Shows a young woman and three elmentary grade students making baskets from a variety of materials including leaves, pine needles, rope and yarn. Demonstrates in detail each step of cording, wrapping, coiling and stitching. Suitable for middle and upper primary levels.
